data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement three per-bot comment parsers (coderabbit-comment-parser.sh, gitar-comment-parser.sh, copilot-comment-parser.sh) that produce canonical-shape events with the correct tool_id field. Each parser handles its bot's quirks (CodeRabbit's structured review body, Gitar Dashboard's row-based edits, Copilot's lack of [bot] suffix with user.type==Bot).

**Why**: Per-bot parsers isolate per-bot drift: a CodeRabbit format change should not break Gitar ingestion. Canonical events let the telemetry store, dedup logic, and auto-resolve work uniformly across bots.

**Scope**:
- IN: coderabbit-comment-parser.sh, gitar-comment-parser.sh, copilot-comment-parser.sh; canonical event schema with tool_id; per-bot test fixtures under tests/fixtures/bot-comments/{coderabbit,gitar,copilot}/
- OUT: Phase A author classification (covered by d1); bot-comment-scan dispatch loop (covered by d2); per-bot CI workflow wiring (covered by d7)

## Done Definitions
- When this story is complete, Each fixture produces canonical event with correct tool_id
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "After this epic ships, a CodeRabbit / Gitar / Copilot review comment on a representative PR does NOT increment our cycle counter, does NOT enter the r")
- When this story is complete, gitar-dashboard then gitar-dashboard-edited: events only for new row 2nd run
  ← Satisfies: sc-5  (sc-5: "Bot-comment dedup is per `(reviewer_id, github_comment_id)` (augmented to include row_content_hash for Gitar Dashboard): the same comment is ingested ")
- When this story is complete, CodeRabbit body-shape match but emoji-header fail -> parse_failure header_drift
  ← Satisfies: sc-6  (sc-6: "Malformed bot comments do not break CI: parser exits 0 with `WARN:` to stderr; same comment failing parsing in 3 consecutive CI runs auto-files a bug ")

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Malformed comment fixture must produce WARN: to stderr and exit 0 — parser drift must never break CI
- [Testing] Per-bot canonical-event assertion uses tool_id discriminator to confirm dispatch wired correctly
- [Foundation/Enhancement candidate] Phase F may split per-bot parser pack: Foundation = CodeRabbit (most common); Enhancement = Gitar + Copilot

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a bot-comment-scan implementer, I can register per-bot parsers (CodeRabbit, Gitar, Copilot) emitting canonical events with correct tool_id so downstream telemetry distinguishes findings by source
